title: Nightly snapshot: once per day, for every location, one row per in-stock non-core part is recorded with its identity, quantity, and values to the cent
custom_preconds:
1. In-stock, non-core parts exist at two or more locations, including a part with non-round cent values.
2. A location with NO in-stock parts also exists.
3. You can inspect the stored snapshot rows after the nightly capture runs (arrange the verification route with the developers).
custom_steps:
1. After the overnight capture, inspect the stored snapshot rows for that calendar date.
2. For a known part, read every captured field.
3. Check the rows for each location, including the empty one.
custom_expected:
1. Once per day, overnight, one row per then-in-stock, non-core part is recorded for every location across every organization, under that day's calendar date.
2. Each row captures the part's identity (part, category, vendor), on-hand quantity, unit cost, unit sell, total cost, and total sell, stored to the cent.
3. A location with no in-stock parts on the date simply has no rows for that date — this is valid, not an error.
